source.title: Observations, measurements and samples (OMS)
source.type: OGC Abstract Specification conceptual/logical model (identical content ISO 19156:2023 apart from branding/legal)

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Host groups Observers, often a monitoring facility or platform; the conceptual model also permits organizational groupings.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A Host is not necessarily a physical station, surveyed sensor location, parent hardware, or proof of an installed Observer.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: An ObservingProcedure describes the steps/method an Observer uses to obtain an ObservableProperty's value; it is reusable across distinct Observers.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A reusable method is not an installed hardware identity or proof the method was executed for a historical event.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: ObservableProperty is an observable quality or characteristic of the feature-of-interest; observations associate exactly one observedProperty.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Outdoor air temperature and logger-panel temperature are not the same observed property merely because both use °C; property != measured value.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Observer is a particular identifiable entity capable of producing Observations with an ObservingProcedure; may be physical instrument, algorithm, person or other implementation.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: The broad DIM label 'Observer / observing System' exceeds OMS: an Observer is not necessarily physical equipment or the CSAPI DataStream publisher.

reviewedRows.originalStandardMeaning: Observation is the act that determines a feature's property value using a method, with exactly one phenomenonTime, resultTime, observedProperty, procedure, and result; the logical core imposes source-context constraints.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A published manufacturer example is not a performed act; a copied API representation is not a new original act. Original Bennett resultTime is UNKNOWN, so fully conformant source-native OMS serialization is not demonstrated.

nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: The period to which the result applies; the standard explicitly uses a time interval for averages of multiple samples. Preserve source coverage and timezone; no unsupported precise interval inferred.

An instant when the result became available; exactly one in a fully modeled Observation. Original Bennett NOAA resultTime remains UNKNOWN and must not be filled with the API publication date or phenomenonTime.

Observation result quality is distinct from equipment health and from the procedure's generic trustworthiness; Bennett's literal F_ATemp='<0> ' and separate blank F_Record must not be normalized away.
Observation result is an instance value, not a reusable native output field/schema position; a measurable result needs appropriate units without inventing native 14-field result bodies.
For an air temperature measurement the observed feature may be a volume of air; station site location, mounted probe and feature-of-interest are distinct subjects.
Allows proxy samples versus ultimate target, not evidence that a particular proxy/sample chain exists in one of our cases.
A deployment assigns an Observer to a Host. The model alone does not create dated EE181 serial role periods, exact change instant, or 2026 installed state.
Event-specific settings/inputs may be recorded as parameters, but a device's factory default is not necessarily the actual setting during an observation.
Relates Observation ACTS; it is not automatically an original-record to derivative API-copy provenance relation and does not turn Bennett two NOAA events into four.
Generic descriptive metadata link does not enforce project-specific original issuer, edition, locator, attestation, source truth grade or signed provenance.
Period during which result is useful is separate from phenomenonTime and resultTime; NOAA station summary does not establish a validity period.
An algorithm or simulation may generate an Observation; source does not reveal the full producing algorithm, aggregation chain or original issuer behind Bennett's summary.

keyBennettFacts: Historical station has two original NOAA ATemp mean events, not four original observations.
Original NOAA resultTime is UNKNOWN; no source-backed full OMS Observation data record possible without handling missingness and conformance honestly.
Original F_ATemp lexical token '<0> ' includes trailing space; F_Record is separate blank field.
Two EE181 serials occupy three dated service statements, not three different probes; OMS Deployment concept alone does not supply exact swap time.
excluded: No data encoding/JSON schema conformance inferred from an abstract conceptual standard
